alphacam_v181_600_registers.header: AI = inch (values/25.4, 4 dec) | AZ = mm (3 dec), from ALPHACAM.MES record 0x0C

N10 block (tool change).#122: tool number (as picked in CHANGE TOOL, e.g. 16)

N20 block (operation).#121: pass number, re-set before every pass
N20 block (operation).#127: operation kind: 6 area clear, 7 internal area clear, 8 face clear, 9 grooving, 10 area clear pre-finish, 11 internal area clear pre-finish, 12 face clear pre-finish, 14 finish pass, 15 internal finish pass, 17 grooving finish mode, 18 drilling, 20 threading, 21 thread spring pass (1 = N10 tool block)

alphat_v12_prg_observed.moves: M60 G0 X Z M61 (rapid) / M62 G1 X Z F (feed) / M64 end of feed group; M63 / M65 / M66 macro calls; IF[#140EQn] GOTO 50n restart
alphat_v12_prg_observed.per pass: N5nn label; #121=n; M66; IF[#140EQn] GOTO 5nn (restart at pass n); M63; M60 G0 ... M61 rapid; M62 G1 ... feed; M64 after the last pass
alphat_v12_prg_observed.drilling: peck cycle written out as G1 moves (in/out per peck), Z x2; SD1 uses G74 ... G174; each peck goes `peck` below the previous one (not below the retract), back-off 2; #125/#126 = start X, bottom Z (no nose offset)
alphat_v12_prg_observed.threading: per pass: M60 G0 to start M61; M62; #121=n; M66; G32 X<dia> Z<end> F<pitch x2>; U<dx> W<-pitch x2> (retract starts one pitch before the end, V1.21); G0 out; SD1 uses G76 ... G176; cut n at radial depth first*sqrt(n) (first cut 1 -> 100 cuts for 10 mm), the depth rounded to the output decimals before doubling; U = outer - inner + 1 (assumed); internal: from the inner line out to the outer one, U negative, #125 = outer; W = -pitch x2
alphat_v12_prg_observed.move/rapid to cursor: no N20 header; moves appended to the current tool block: M62 G1 X Z F / M60 G0 X Z M61
alphat_v12_prg_observed.grooving: plunges written as G1 in / G1 out (+2 on diameter) per stepover, Z x2; #125/#126 = groove limits; SD1 uses G75 ... G175 with the groove contour; plunges from (top Z - tip width) every stepover, an extra plunge on each left wall, depth = highest drawn diameter under the tip (drawn profile, not the tip path)
alphat_v12_prg_observed.face clear: passes along X at Z = -2*depth*n; each pass has its own N5nn restart label; #125/#126 = billet limits (Z x2); SD1 G71 ... G171; the profile's faces split it into zones, each cut from its top face in depth steps, the last clamped onto the next face (Z-2..-24, -25, -27..-49, -50); pull-off -0.4 X +0.2 Z, then rapid to (start X - 0.8, Z + 0.6)
alphat_v12_prg_observed.arcs: G2 (CW) / G3 (CCW) X Z I K F: I = centre X - start X as a DIAMETER increment, K = centre Z - start Z (x2). The PRG contour is the imaginary tool-tip path: nose-centre path (SD1) shifted by -r in X (radius; +r internal) and -r in Z, so lines along the axes stay on the drawing while arcs become radius R+r (convex) / R-r (concave) and sloped lines move.
alphat_v12_prg_observed.blocks: each operation block is followed by an empty block (M66, restart IF, label); when a tool change follows, that block holds the rapid to the tool change point (M60 G0 X Z M61). A mid-program tool change is a tool block like N10 (#121 #122 #123 #124 #127=1 #129 #130).
alphat_v12_prg_observed.offsets: OFFSET X (radius) / Z translate the contour: X + 2*ox, Z + oz; points on the axis (X0) stay at X0. Area clear passes step from the translated max X; the floor (Xmin - 2r) and #125/#126 do not move.
alphat_v12_prg_observed.pre-finish: area clear with pre-finish = yes: after the area block and its empty block, a finish-pass block with #127=10 and a 1 mm (not 0.2) 45-degree pull-off, then its own empty block
alphat_v12_prg_observed.area clear zones: every Z-parallel profile diameter between the start and the limit gets its own pass and the stepping restarts from it (inch: ... 2.426, 2.4, 2.2426 ...)
alphat_v12_prg_observed.inch rounding: toolpaths use the nose radius rounded to 4 decimals (0.0157), #125/#126 the exact one; pre-finish pull-off = area retract as entered (0.0394) at 45 deg
alphat_v12_prg_observed.scaling: Z, feed and thread pitch are all 2x the drawing value (mm and inch); X (diameter) is 1:1; SD1 is unscaled. Confirmed on the control for Z and feed (the T macros halve them, RE_NOTES Progress 29); pitch not yet seen on the control.
